campus_metadata.location: Kharagpur, Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal, India

properties.name: Main Administrative Building (Tower Block)
properties.notes: Historic clock tower, administrative offices, central lawn

properties.name: Nalanda Classroom Complex
properties.notes: Primary lecture complex with high student density during class hours

properties.name: Takshashila Academic Complex
properties.notes: Multistory academic classrooms and examination centers

properties.name: Dept of Computer Science & Engineering
properties.notes: High AC heat rejection; mostly indoor air-conditioned computing labs

properties.name: Dept of Electrical Engineering
properties.notes: Heavy laboratory equipment with high power density

properties.name: Dept of Mechanical Engineering & Workshops
properties.notes: Large industrial metal roofs, high thermal storage, lower AC coverage in workshop bays

properties.name: Central Library
properties.notes: Cooling sanctuary during peak daytime hours for students

properties.name: Kalidas Auditorium
properties.notes: Large auditorium space with concrete plaza surrounding

properties.name: Nehru Hall of Residence (PAN Loop)
properties.notes: Student residential hall; high nocturnal thermal exposure; relies on natural ventilation

properties.name: Patel Hall of Residence (PAN Loop)
properties.notes: Student residential hall; substantial evening heat trap in top-floor rooms

properties.name: Azad Hall of Residence (PAN Loop)
properties.notes: Student residential hall; high non-AC population exposure

properties.name: Rajendra Prasad (RP) Hall of Residence
properties.notes: Located on Boundary Road with high residential density

properties.name: Radhakrishnan (RK) Hall of Residence

properties.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri (LBS) Hall
properties.notes: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hall (located to the left of MMM Hall)

properties.name: Dr. B. C. Roy Technology Hospital
properties.notes: Primary campus healthcare facility; vulnerable patients sensitive to heat stress

properties.name: Technology Guest House
properties.notes: Well-shaded garden campus context with high air-conditioning coverage

properties.name: Tata Sports Complex & Swimming Pool
properties.notes: Outdoor sports courts, tennis courts, and track; zero afternoon shade

properties.name: Jnan Ghosh Stadium (Main Athletic Ground)

properties.name: Technology Students Gymkhana
properties.notes: Hub of student extracurricular activities, outdoor courts, and plaza

properties.name: Central Industrial Workshop Complex
properties.notes: Dark corrugated roofs, manufacturing machinery, high thermal mass

properties.name: Scholars Avenue Main Traffic Corridor
properties.notes: Paved asphalt roadway corridor connecting residential PAN loop to academics

properties.name: Tikka Lake & Wetland Microclimate Zone

properties.name: Science & Technology Entrepreneurs Park (STEP)
properties.notes: Incubation and startup offices

properties.name: Student Activity Centre (Old SAC) Grounds
